goal: Return the business-day count between two ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD), excluding weekends
assumptions: Input dates are strings in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD.
The count is inclusive of both start and end dates if they are business days.
If start date is after end date, the function returns 0 (no negative counts).
Dates are valid calendar dates; no validation for invalid dates is required.
The function does not account for public holidays.

test_history.reason: verifier dispute: test_leap_year_february: Changed expected value from 4 to 5. The verifier is correct; the range 2024-02-26 (Monday) to 2024-03-01 (Friday) inclusive contains 5 business days (Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri).

results.description: Uses weekday() > 4 to count weekends instead of weekdays, so returns weekend count
